metric_definitions.label: accuracy (all)
metric_definitions.basis: plain score reading: the expected level, rounded (.5 up); correct / labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: MAE (levels)
metric_definitions.basis: expected level; mean absolute error in levels over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: QWK
metric_definitions.basis: plain score reading: the expected level, rounded (.5 up); quadratic weighted kappa over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: AUROC
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; mean over the cuts k of AUROC(label >= k, P(level >= k)) over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: Brier score
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; ranked probability score over (levels - 1), over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: ECE
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; calibration of the rounded level's correctness over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: MAE (levels)
metric_definitions.basis: configured primary objective; plain score reading: the expected level, rounded (.5 up); denominator: labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: QWK
metric_definitions.basis: configured tiebreak objective; primary plain rule; denominator: labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accuracy (all)
metric_definitions.basis: configured tiebreak objective; primary plain rule; denominator: labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: coverage (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed accepted / labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accepted accuracy (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed correct accepted / accepted labelled dev cases
